PROJECT.STARTUPSTORA: select klmasterrobaid, sortkey, Naziv, oznaka, oznaka2 as DodatnaOznaka from klmasterroba order by sortkey
PROJECT.NAME: DODKLAZUR

FRMEDIT.NAME: FRMEDIT
